title: a cache entry outlives the decoding context its memory came from
live_proof: inspection at the 17.0 pin: src/backend/replication/pgoutput/pgoutput.c:429 makes data->cachectx a child of the decoding context ctx->context, and :857 makes each entry->entry_cxt a grandchild, while RelationSyncCache is a static (:210) initialised into CacheMemoryContext at :524. The comment at :1698-1701 states that cachectx is deliberately not cleaned because the decoding machinery will free it, and pgoutput_shutdown:1703 destroys only the hash. An error path that tears down ctx->context without running that shutdown therefore leaves the long-lived cache pointing into a dead arena. The pre-fix shape is present.
object: a row filter allocated in entry_cxt, a grandchild of the decoding context
lifetime_ender: an error tears down the decoding context while RelationSyncCache keeps pointing into it
shape: stale pointer into a deleted ancestor
